fields.h1: Build PDF Automation for the Paperwork Your Team Repeats
fields.hero_description: Get PDF automation that reads the files coming in and writes the ones going out, built from one prompt.
fields.features_heading: What the App Does With Each PDF
fields.features_subheading: Some PDFs arrive from customers and crews, others go out to clients, and the app handles both directions.
fields.feature_1:
Scans split into one file per document

The app cuts a multi-page scan at each new document and reads the values you name, such as an order number or a date. Each document is then attached to the record it belongs to.
fields.feature_2:
A reviewer confirms unclear values

When a value is read with low confidence, that one field goes to a reviewer with the page shown beside it. The record waits until the reviewer confirms or corrects that value.
fields.feature_3:
New PDFs written from your records

Describe the layout once, and the app writes a PDF for each row that needs one, with its own name and number. Each PDF is emailed to the address on the record and saved there.
fields.feature_4:
The fillable PDFs you already use

Upload the form your clients know, and the app writes each answer from a phone checklist into its box. The signer signs on screen, and the signed copy is saved with the job.
fields.feature_5:
A job's files merged in your order

Set the order once, such as the quote first and the invoice last. When a job closes, the app merges the PDFs attached to it, numbers the pages, and names the file by job number.
fields.feature_6:
Every file in a database you own

Each record and every PDF attached to it sit in a database you own, and the app runs with no task cap. The full code exports to your own GitHub repository on paid plans.

fields.usecase_heading: Where the App Takes Over the PDF Work
fields.tab_content_1:
One scan in, 24 receipts filed by order number

Each evening Coldspring Beverage Distributors scans the day's 24 signed delivery receipts into one PDF. The app splits it into one file per receipt and attaches 23 to their orders by order number. One receipt has a smudged order number, and Dasha Petrakis on the order desk gets that field to confirm.
fields.tab_content_2:
Numbered certificates for all 38 who passed

When Stonebridge Safety Institute closes a forklift operator course, the app writes a PDF certificate for each of the 38 attendees who passed, with the name, course, date, and its own number. Each one goes out by email. Ingrid Sorvino's copy is SSI-1042, and the same file is saved to her record.
fields.tab_content_3:
Benedetta signs before Kaito leaves the roof

Kaito Odhiambo of Vossberg Mechanical works through an 18-item checklist on his phone at a rooftop unit and marks 2 items for follow-up. The site contact, Benedetta Coyle, signs on his screen. The app writes his answers and her signature into Vossberg's 2-page inspection PDF and emails her a copy.
fields.tab_content_4:
Job 2417 closes and its 5 files become 9 pages

When Fairhaven Remodeling marks job 2417 complete, the app merges the 5 PDFs attached to it in a set order. The packet opens with the signed quote, then 2 change orders, the final inspection, and the final invoice. It numbers the 9 pages, names the packet 2417 closeout, and emails it to Celeste Tamura.

fields.howto_description: Follow 7 steps to set up PDF automation for one document type, checked against real copies before it handles new ones.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick one document and save 10 copies
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Describe the app in one prompt
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Connect the inbox and the drive
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose the PDF your team handles most and save 10 recent copies, including your messiest scan. These copies become the test set for every later step.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Circle each value a person copies into another system today, such as a customer ID or a due date. Each one becomes a field in the app's records.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write the prompt the way you would brief a new hire: where the PDFs arrive, what to pull out, and where each record goes. Emergent builds the app and its database from a prompt.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Connect the inbox or scanner folder where PDFs arrive and the drive where finished documents belong, through their APIs. Add Slack or email for the review alerts.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Pick one reviewer for each document type, and list the fields that always need a person, such as totals over an amount you set.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Give it one PDF you sent as the model
fields.howto_step_6_des: For documents the app writes, upload one you sent recently as the layout to copy. Ask for changes to spacing, fonts, or the logo by prompting until its output matches.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run the 10 saved copies through it
fields.howto_step_7_des: Compare each record the app creates with the values a person typed for that copy. Fix any misread field by prompting, then switch on the live inbox.

faq_plan.a: PDF automation is the use of automated processes to handle routine document tasks such as generating, organizing, or routing files without constant manual input. The four examples above split between reading PDFs that arrive and producing PDFs that go out.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up PDF automation?
faq_plan.a: Start with one document type and a handful of real copies of it, then write down where those PDFs arrive and which values your team needs from them. Emergent's AI automation builder creates the app, its records, and its review screen from a plain-English prompt. When a customer switches to a new form layout later, you change the app by prompting.

faq_plan.q: How does PDF automation fill in a fillable form from my records?
faq_plan.a: Upload the fillable PDF and map each of its boxes to a column in your records or a question on a web form. The app then writes each value into its matching box and saves a new filled copy for every record. If you cannot click into the boxes of your form, ask for the text to be placed by position on the page instead.

faq_plan.q: Can PDF automation create documents from a template I already use?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Give the app a PDF you sent recently as the model, and it lays out each new document the same way, filled from the record behind it. For quotes that also need follow-up after they go out, proposal automation covers what happens once the client opens the document.

faq_plan.q: What should I look for in PDF automation software?
faq_plan.a: Look at how it handles your own documents first, including your worst scan, before you compare feature lists. Then check where the extracted values are stored, whether you can take them with you, and whether the price rises with every document processed. In an app Emergent builds, the records stay in your own database, and runs have no task cap.

faq_plan.q: What happens when PDF automation misreads a field?
faq_plan.a: In an app Emergent builds, a field read with low confidence goes to a person before it reaches your records. Decide which fields always need a person anyway, such as bank details, and keep a log of each correction so you can see which senders cause the most of them.

faq_plan.q: Can PDF automation turn survey results into a report?
faq_plan.a: Yes. When a survey closes, the app can total the responses and lay them out as a PDF with one chart per question, then email it to the people who need it. A ranking survey, for example, becomes a report that lists each option by its average rank.

faq_plan.q: Can PDF automation merge several documents into one packet?
faq_plan.a: Set a fixed order for the documents and a trigger, such as a job being marked complete, and the app merges whatever PDFs are attached in that order. Decide ahead of time what happens when one is missing: hold the packet and alert the job owner, or send it with a note on the first page about the gap.

faq_plan.q: Are free PDF automation tools enough for a small team?
faq_plan.a: Try a free option on a real batch first. If your team still retypes values from the PDFs into another system afterward, you need something that connects to that system, not only a tool that edits files. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: How do I use PDF automation to send each person their own copy?
faq_plan.a: Keep one record per person and one layout, and the app fills a separate PDF for each record and emails it to the address on that row. After a leadership survey, for example, each manager can get a PDF with only their own team's scores. Send the first batch to yourself and open a few side by side before it goes out.

plan.angle: The top 10 for pdf automation are tool pages and tutorials about one file operation at a time: an Acrobat scripting shop, an RPA video, a merge-and-compress workflow, a listicle of editors. This page shows PDF automation as an app around the documents a business already handles, in both directions: a day of scanned delivery receipts split and filed by order number with unclear values sent to a person, numbered course certificates written for each passing attendee, a fillable inspection form filled from a phone checklist and signed on screen, and a closeout packet merged from a job's files. Retyping values from forms belongs to data entry automation, template assembly of letters and quotes to document automation, scheduled business reports to report automation.
